sourceClaim: Keep foundational programs while fitting complementary practice around changing schedules; progressive learning does not automatically certify later technical skills.
appDecisions: Use the existing continuity opt-in/default and actual completed practice, with no new settings or saved active-path state.
Reserved core work and genuine unfinished work keep priority. Recent developing return practice can receive a follow-up across intervening core sessions.
First clean learning practice receives cross-core follow-up only when the current core has actual time-blocked work, and only while the existing supporting-practice requirement remains unmet.

At most two additional developing opportunities before another ready developing peer receives its turn. Two successive actual developing retention priorities yield when a never-practiced ready peer is waiting; the core remains protected.
Current method/load, skills, pain, recovery, time and actual-qualification rules remain mandatory; forecasts never assume future completion.
limits: The follow-up count, skill-exposure gate and retention bound are application choices, not Wildman numerical prescriptions.
This does not establish a complete active/developing/maintenance curriculum, a universal movement frequency or complete transcript integration.
Controlled scheduling tradeoffs are reported, including delayed milestones and any additional reduced return in a longer-duration case.
No automatic technical confirmation, component credit, source-dose modification or data migration is introduced.
